blocks.orig: The Dar es Salaam Serena Hotel provides its guests with 230 stylishly designed, beautifully appointed rooms and suites. Here, you enjoy a classic decor featuring large beds, ensuite bathrooms, plush carpets and windows with an impressive view of the Indian Ocean or the glittering Dar es Salaam cityscape. With culinary offerings ranging from freshly caught seafood to Indian and African specialities, Dar es Salaam Serena Hotel offers a choice between two distinctive restaurants – Serengeti and Jahazi. Besides, the Kibo Bar, the Pool Bar and the charming Bakers Basket Patisserie and Coffee Shop meet any taste and occasion one might have.
blocks.html: The Dar es Salaam Serena Hotel has 230 stylish, beautifully furnished rooms and suites for its guests. You can expect classic decor with large beds, en-suite bathrooms, soft carpets and windows looking out over the Indian Ocean or the sparkling Dar es Salaam skyline. For dining there are two distinctive restaurants to choose from – Serengeti and Jahazi – serving everything from freshly caught seafood to Indian and African specialities. In addition, the Kibo Bar, the Pool Bar and the charming Bakers Basket Patisserie and Coffee Shop cater for every taste and occasion.
